content.value_statement: Investors need fast earnings context without rebuilding data pulls and report structure each quarter. This skill gathers Longbridge data and turns it into previews, summary cards, or full Markdown research reports.
actual_capabilities: Chooses a pre-earnings preview or post-earnings workflow based on the request.
Runs the included collector to gather Longbridge CLI data for one ticker.
Creates lite earnings cards with KPI, segment, margin, guidance, and risk sections.
Drafts full Markdown earnings reports when the user asks for deeper analysis.
Applies DCF, trading comps, and precedent transaction methods in full reports.
Supports English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese responses.
limitations: Primary data access requires the Longbridge CLI or a configured Longbridge MCP server.
Transcript, consensus history, and transaction data may require web search.
Outputs are research summaries and do not replace licensed financial advice.
Coverage quality depends on available company, segment, estimate, and filing data.

use_cases.title: Prepare for an earnings release
use_cases.description: Review prior guidance, recent events, analyst questions, and key metrics before results are announced.

use_cases.title: Summarize a fresh earnings print
use_cases.description: Turn Longbridge data into a compact beat or miss summary with segment, margin, and guidance context.

use_cases.title: Draft a full earnings research report
use_cases.description: Build a Markdown report with estimates, thesis updates, valuation scenarios, and source notes.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner earnings summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when results are out and the user wants a short answer.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the latest earnings for AAPL.US using the lite format. Focus on revenue, EPS, margins, guidance, and major risks.

prompt_templates.title: Pre-earnings preview
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a scheduled earnings release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-earnings preview for 700.HK. Include prior guidance, recent events, last call Q&A themes, consensus gaps, and key questions.

prompt_templates.title: Full post-earnings report
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the user asks for a research-style deliverable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a full Markdown earnings update for MSFT.US. Include beat or miss analysis, segment trends, guidance, estimate revisions, valuation, and rating rationale.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced valuation-focused review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when valuation and target price changes are the main question.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze TSLA.US after earnings with emphasis on DCF, trading comps, bear-base-bull scenarios, target price change, and thesis implications.

output_examples.input: Analyze the latest earnings for Tencent.
output: A concise earnings card with company name, ticker, period, rating, target price, and current price.
KPI tables showing reported values, growth, and estimate beat or miss status.
Segment revenue, margin trend, thesis status, next-quarter consensus, and risk tags.

output_examples.input: Give me a pre-earnings preview for Apple.
output: A preview covering prior management guidance, recent events, last call questions, and market expectations.
A checklist of metrics to watch and risk factors that could change the investment view.

output_examples.input: Generate a full report after Nvidia earnings.
output: A Markdown research report with earnings summary, revenue analysis, segments, profitability, guidance, estimates, and valuation.
A chat recap with verdict, key takeaways, estimate changes, rating, and target price.

best_practices: Provide a ticker, market suffix, and whether the company has already reported.
Ask for lite mode when you need a fast summary and full report mode when you need valuation detail.
Review any detected reporting period and correct it if the company uses a nonstandard fiscal calendar.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill for initiation reports or broad company profiles without an earnings event.
Do not treat outputs as investment advice or a guarantee of future returns.
Do not ask it to fabricate missing segment, estimate, transcript, or guidance data.

faq.question: What data source does this skill prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Longbridge CLI data and uses web search only for gaps such as transcripts or transaction data.

faq.question: Can it handle both previews and reported results?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses a pre-earnings workflow before results and a post-earnings workflow after results are released.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: Lite mode replies in chat. Full report mode creates a Markdown report only when the user asks for it.

faq.question: Which markets are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is designed for US, Hong Kong, and A-share tickers when Longbridge data is available.

faq.question: Can it calculate a target price?
faq.answer: Yes, full report mode can use DCF, trading comparables, and precedent transactions when enough data exists.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It produces research summaries and valuation work for review, not personalized financial advice.
